meta.name: app-store-optimization
meta.description: App Store Optimization (ASO) toolkit for researching keywords, analyzing competitor rankings, generating metadata suggestions, and improving app visibility on Apple App Store and Google Play Store. Use when the user asks about ASO, app store rankings, app metadata, app titles and descriptions, app store listings, app visibility, or mobile app marketing on iOS or Android. Supports keyword research and scoring, competitor keyword analysis, metadata optimization, A/B test planning, launch checklists, and tracking ranking changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 提升应用在应用商店的曝光和下载量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在优化应用商店列表以提高排名和转化率。
copy.tagline_en: Boost your app's visibility and downloads on app stores.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are optimizing app store listings to improve rankings and conversions.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会在你咨询应用商店优化(ASO)时,按步骤执行关键词研究、元数据优化、竞争对手分析等工作流,并输出关键词评分、验证清单和优化建议。
howto.when: 当你说出 “ASO”、“应用商店排名”、“应用元数据” 等关键词,或询问应用可见度、iOS/Android 移动应用营销时触发。

say.text: 帮我研究一下我这款待办事项 App 的关键词,按相关性和搜索量排个序。
say.note: Claude 会执行关键词研究工作流并评分排序。

say.text: App 标题只有 30 个字符,帮我优化标题和关键词字段。
say.note: Claude 会检查字符限制并给出优化文案。

say.text: 分析一下我在应用商店的前 10 个竞争对手,找出关键词差距。
say.note: Claude 会构建关键词矩阵并识别差距。

howto.what_en: After installation, when you ask about App Store Optimization (ASO), Claude runs workflows like keyword research, metadata optimization, and competitor analysis step by step, and produces keyword scores, validation checklists, and optimization suggestions.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention 'ASO', 'app store rankings', 'app metadata' or similar keywords, or ask about app visibility or iOS/Android mobile app marketing.

say_en.text: Research keywords for my todo app and rank by relevance and search volume.
say_en.note: Claude runs the keyword research workflow and scores them.

say_en.text: My app title has only 30 chars. Help optimize the title and keyword field.
say_en.note: Claude checks limits and suggests optimized copy.

say_en.text: Analyze my top 10 competitors on the app store and find keyword gaps.
say_en.note: Claude builds a keyword matrix and identifies gaps.
